title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 33 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 33)

content.overview: Section 33 provides a limited post-award mechanism for correction of computation, clerical or typographical errors, interpretation of a specific point or part of the award where agreed, and an additional award on claims presented but omitted from the award, subject to the statutory requirements and time limits.
